name: design-md-lint-contrast
expected_output: Runs the bundled design-md.js linter and reports the failing component contrast pair as an error with a passing replacement colour, while explaining why the large-text and translucent cases differ

assertions.name: uses-cli
assertions.description: runs scripts/design-md.js lint instead of judging the YAML by eye

assertions.name: flags-caption
assertions.description: reports components.caption-muted (#949494 on #ffffff, 3.03:1) as below WCAG AA 4.5:1

assertions.name: large-text-passes
assertions.description: does not flag hero-title, because 32px bold text only needs 3:1

assertions.name: translucent-warning
assertions.description: describes glass-panel as a warning that depends on the backdrop, not a definite failure

assertions.name: concrete-fix
assertions.description: proposes a replacement text colour and confirms it passes by re-running lint

name: design-md-import-css-vars
prompt: /design-md import ./scripts/test/fixtures/design-md/tokens.css (project has .naksha/ but no design-system/ yet)
expected_output: Converts the CSS custom properties to DESIGN.md with from-tokens, relays the skipped dark-mode and shadow notes, offers to save it as .naksha/design-system/MASTER.md, and replaces the placeholder prose

assertions.name: uses-from-tokens
assertions.description: runs design-md.js from-tokens on the CSS file

assertions.name: relays-notes
assertions.description: tells the user the dark-mode overrides were not imported because DESIGN.md has no modes

assertions.name: primary-alias
assertions.description: mentions that primary was aliased to {colors.brand} and can be changed

assertions.name: offers-master
assertions.description: offers to save the result as .naksha/design-system/MASTER.md rather than writing it unasked

assertions.name: real-prose
assertions.description: replaces the generated placeholder notes with actual design rationale before linting

name: design-md-page-override
prompt: /design-md page checkout — the checkout should use a teal accent instead of copper and drop the promo badge (MASTER.md already exists)
expected_output: Writes a partial DESIGN.md to .naksha/design-system/pages/checkout.md with only the changed tokens, uses null to remove the badge, explains the deviation in prose, and lints the merged system

assertions.name: page-path
assertions.description: writes .naksha/design-system/pages/checkout.md

assertions.name: only-differences
assertions.description: the override holds only the accent change and the badge removal, not a copy of MASTER.md

assertions.name: null-removal
assertions.description: removes the promo badge with `promo-badge: null` under components

assertions.name: merged-lint
assertions.description: runs `design-md.js lint --page checkout` to check the merged system

assertions.name: precedence
assertions.description: states the precedence: page override > MASTER.md > brand defaults

name: design-system-import-design-md
expected_output: Detects a DESIGN.md source (Mode E), lints it, generates CSS custom properties from its tokens with the export command, carries the prose rules into component guidance, and persists MASTER.md when .naksha/ exists

assertions.name: mode-e
assertions.description: treats the file as an imported DESIGN.md instead of generating a new palette

assertions.name: lints-first
assertions.description: runs design-md.js lint before using the tokens

assertions.name: exports-css
assertions.description: produces tokens.css via `design-md.js export --to css` with values matching the file (e.g. --color-primary: #1F3A5F)

assertions.name: uses-prose
assertions.description: applies the file's Do's and Don'ts (one primary action per view, no accent text on paper)

assertions.name: keeps-output-contract
assertions.description: still outputs CSS custom properties with a usage example

name: design-system-export-dtcg
prompt: /design-system brand color #2563EB, editorial serif, comfortable density --export dtcg
expected_output: Generates the token system as usual, persists it as MASTER.md, and exports a DTCG 2025.10 tokens.json via design-md.js with the correct value shapes

assertions.name: normal-generation
assertions.description: still runs Mode A and outputs CSS custom properties

assertions.name: dtcg-export
assertions.description: writes tokens.json using `design-md.js export --to dtcg`

assertions.name: dtcg-shapes
assertions.description: colours use { colorSpace, components, hex } objects and dimensions use { value, unit }, not bare strings

assertions.name: schema-url
assertions.description: the file declares $schema https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/format.json

assertions.name: lossy-notes
assertions.description: relays any notes about values DTCG cannot express (kept under $extensions)

name: design-reads-master-and-page
prompt: /design checkout page with order summary and payment form (project has .naksha/design-system/MASTER.md and pages/checkout.md overriding the accent to #0F766E)
expected_output: Loads the design system in Step 0.6 via `design-md.js resolve --page checkout`, applies the page override's teal accent over the master copper, and notes which files were used

assertions.name: resolves-page
assertions.description: runs `design-md.js resolve --page checkout` (or reads both files) before designing

assertions.name: override-wins
assertions.description: uses #0F766E for the accent, not the master value

assertions.name: master-fills
assertions.description: keeps master tokens the override does not change (typography, spacing, button radius)

assertions.name: follows-prose
assertions.description: applies the override's rationale (calmer payment step, larger touch targets)

assertions.name: notes-source
assertions.description: notes 'Using design system: MASTER.md + pages/checkout.md'
